description: This file defines a templated WebSocket endpoint class 'WSEndpoint' within the WebSockets namespace. The class manages WebSocket connections, including sending messages, handling connection events, and running an event loop. It uses multiple template parameters to customize roles, messaging, ping-pong keepalive, and encryption strategies, and includes private members for connection management and callback functions.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket server endpoints with customizable roles, messaging, ping-pong, and encryption strategies.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.description: Retrieves the connection object associated with a given connection handler.

methods.description: Registers event handlers for WebSocket events.
